name: Tongling Jingda Special Magnet Wire Co., Ltd.
summary: Tongling Jingda Special Magnet Wire Co., Ltd. research, development, manufacturing and sells special electromagnetic wires, special conductors and precision molds in China and internationally. The company offers enameled aluminum wire, such as round, flat, and copper clad aluminum; bare copper wire and oxygen free copper rods; specialty wires, including litz, stranded bare copper, and parallel wires; and drawing dies wires. Its products are used in vehicles, industrial, appliances, renewable energy, electronics, and 5G and data communication industries. In addition, it exports its products.
